description: Change the user's decimal separator (DOT = 1,234.56, COMMA = 1.234,56), or opt in or out of marketing and product-update emails and push notifications. Pass only what the user asked to change; at least one field. Security and transactional messages always send and cannot be turned off. Only call this when the user explicitly asks. Returns the settings after the change. Language and theme are app-only.
name: update_settings
